post.description: When you have one gene name or ID from a paper, dataset or user and need the official human symbol and the gene's IDs in other databases. For many genes at once use `resolve`; for genes you can only describe use `search`.

gene.description: A human gene symbol, alias or previous symbol (`TP53`, `p53`, `HER2`, `SEPT7`; case-insensitive), an HGNC ID (`HGNC:11998`), NCBI Gene ID (`7157`), Ensembl gene ID (`ENSG00000141510`), UniProt accession (`P04637`), RefSeq transcript (`NM_000546.6`), or the MGI or RGD ID of a mouse or rat ortholog.

url.description: A genenames.org symbol report URL, e.g. `https://www.genenames.org/data/gene-symbol-report/#!/hgnc_id/HGNC:11998`. Exactly one of `gene` and `url`.

200.description:
One human gene's approved HGNC record, from whatever you have: a symbol, alias or previous symbol, an HGNC, NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, RefSeq, MGI or RGD ID, or a genenames.org URL. Says how the input matched, and returns the approved symbol and name, aliases, previous symbols, locus type, location, gene groups and cross-references (NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, OMIM, RefSeq, MANE Select, CCDS, MGI, RGD, Orphanet, PubMed). An alias shared by several genes is an `ambiguous` result listing every candidate, and a withdrawn HGNC ID that was merged resolves to the gene it went into. Unknown genes are `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `candidates` | object[] | Other records the input matches (for `ambiguous`, all of them), strongest match first. |
| `gene` | object | The resolved record; null when `resolution` is `ambiguous`. |
| `input` | string | The gene string as given. |
| `license` | object | HGNC releases all data under CC0 (genenames.org/about/license); attribution is recommended, not required. |
| `matched_on` | string | How the input matched `gene`, or what the ambiguous candidates share. |
| `note` | string | One plain sentence on the resolution, e.g. `p53 is an alias of TP53 (HGNC:11998); the approved symbol is TP53.` |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `resolution` | string | `resolved` (one approved record), `ambiguous` (several records tie, so `gene` is null and `candidates` lists them) or `withdrawn` (only a withdrawn entry matches). |

200.description:
Check up to 50 human gene symbols or IDs in one call, like HGNC's multi-symbol checker. Each input comes back `resolved` to its approved symbol (saying whether it matched an approved symbol, previous symbol, alias or ID), `ambiguous` with every candidate, `withdrawn`, or `not_found`, in input order. When none matches, the result is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| `matched_on` | string | How the input matched; null when not found. |
| `note` | string | One plain sentence on the resolution. |

200.description:
Search HGNC's human genes by free text, where every word must match a symbol, alias, name or other field (`kinase`, `17p13.1`, `zinc finger`), or by HGNC field syntax (`symbol:ZNF*`, `name:"potassium channel" AND locus_type:"gene with protein product"`). Filters for locus group and status; approved genes only by default. An exact symbol, previous-symbol or alias match ranks first. Each result has the HGNC ID, approved symbol and name, locus group and type, location, aliases, previous symbols, and NCBI Gene, Ensembl and UniProt IDs. Offset-paginated; an empty result is a valid empty page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alias_symbols` | string[] | Other symbols in use for this gene (not approved). |
| `ensembl_gene_id` | string | Ensembl gene ID (ENSG...). |
| `hgnc_id` | string | HGNC ID, e.g. `HGNC:11998`. |
| `location` | string | Cytogenetic location, e.g. `17p13.1`; null when HGNC records none. |
| `locus_group` | string | Locus group, e.g. `protein-coding gene`, `non-coding RNA`, `pseudogene`, `other`. |
| `locus_type` | string | Locus type, e.g. `gene with protein product`, `RNA, long non-coding`. |
| `name` | string | Approved gene name. |
| `ncbi_gene_id` | string | NCBI Gene (Entrez) ID; joins gene-ncbi-nlm-nih-gov. |
| `previous_symbols` | string[] | Symbols this gene was approved under before. |
| `score` | number | HGNC relevance score. |
| `source_url` | string | The gene's symbol report on genenames.org. |
| `status` | string | `approved`, or `withdrawn` for an entry HGNC no longer maintains. |
| `symbol` | string | Approved symbol (for a withdrawn entry, the symbol it had). |
| `uniprot_ids` | string[] | UniProtKB accessions; join uniprot-org. |
